instruction_loading.mechanism: GEMINI.md or configured context file, with generated adapter routing to project policy.

git.mechanism: Local Git tool availability and repository policy.

secure_github.mechanism: Normal GitHub OAuth/app/device authentication outside prompts.

persistent_storage.mechanism: Git repositories and approved machine-local state.

background_scheduling.mechanism: No platform-neutral assumption; external scheduler evidence required.

subagents.mechanism: Gemini CLI subagents where supported and explicitly configured.

inbox_events.mechanism: Explicit polling or external event source.

secret_storage.mechanism: OS/provider secret store outside source and prompts.

deployment_boundary.mechanism: Profile adoption does not deploy services.
